rule: IAM-A(cell) = H(eps) / (P_cell * H(eps0)); P_cell = H(eps_healthy) / H(eps0) for healthy cells of that type, measured on the SAME read-level pipeline and frozen

neutrophils.source: Loyfer 2023 blood granulocytes GSM5652313/14/15 (GEO GSE186458), hg19 .pat files, WHOLE files; isolated errors and opportunities from doors/data/DEV_IAMA_REAL_01/*_whole_bundle.json
neutrophils.definition_of_P: per donor: H(mean eps of the other donors) / H(eps0); P = mean of the 3

pipeline_note: P is valid only for the pipeline it was measured on; any other read-level pipeline needs its own P from healthy cells of the type; P is valid only for whole-file readings (a reading over part of the genome reads other sites: DEV-IAMA-REAL-01: the copy error over the first 60 MB of each file is 4.7-6.6 % below the whole-file copy error, and the same healthy files read 1.034-1.063 whole against P measured on the first 60 MB)

supersedes.iama_positions_v1: P 1.099, measured on the first 60,000,000 bytes of each file (one stretch of chr1); kept as a record
